SELECT o.id, o.customer_id 
FROM orders o 
JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id, MAX(created_at) AS max_created_at 
    FROM orders 
    GROUP BY customer_id
) AS latest_orders ON o.customer_id = latest_orders.customer_id 
AND o.created_at = latest_orders.max_created_at 
ORDER BY o.id;

FROM orders o
WHERE o.created_at = (SELECT MAX(x.created_at) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = o.customer_id)
ORDER BY o.id;
